propositions: One-time backfill script must sample historical commits at configurable cadence (default monthly) and measure cyclomatic complexity (via lizard) and clone count (via jscpd) at each commit
Measurement seam function measure_tree(tree_path) must shell to both tools, parse their outputs, and return {complexity: int, clone_count: int} or None if either tool fails
Each snapshot written via write_snapshot must be tagged with the commit's own ISO date (git show -s --format=%cI) not wall-clock time, so backfilled trends preserve historical accuracy
A sampled commit where measure_tree fails or returns None must be skipped without aborting the entire backfill (non-fatal, logged)
All written snapshots must carry source=snapshot and confidence=high labels alongside their complexity and clone_count integer values
